issue: spec max_seq_len 262144 is not a multiple of chunk_size 5120, but update_padded_kv_cache needs cache seq_local % chunk_local == 0
fix: allocate KV capacity rounded up to a whole number of chunks (266240 = 52x5120); max_seq_len stays the runtime contract bound

issue: ring SDPA at head_dim 256 and the fused GDN op at 10k tokens decide the layout, but D2 says to write mocks before any device work
fix: ran op-level derisk tests (ring SDPA, GDN) right after mesh-up, then wrote layer.py outline with real signatures

issue: hybrid model: 48 of 64 layers are Gated DeltaNet with a fixed recurrent+conv state instead of per-token K/V; no prefill package has one
fix: KV slots only for the 16 attention layers; GDN state per layer beside the cache; graded as k=recurrent_state, v=conv_state

issue: GDN recurrence runs across the whole sequence but SP shards the sequence over 8 rows
fix: all-gather GDN q/k/v/gate streams over SP; every row runs the chunk's full recurrence, then mesh_partition keeps its own tokens

issue: minimax L1_SMALL_SIZE 1152 B fills with ttnn.all_gather/all_reduce semaphores after ~a dozen distinct CCL program shapes
fix: reserve 32 KiB of L1_SMALL at mesh open

why: only the emb-on-TP (vocab replicated) mode is implemented; the vocab-on-SP mode is a memory optimisation not needed at 27B
checkpoint is plain bf16, nothing to dequantize (a host loader shape test is kept instead)

issue: repo pytest-timeout default (300 s) kills the 64-layer real-weight acceptance run mid read-back
fix: timeout mark of 7200 s on the acceptance test; KV read-back slices only the written rows

issue: model amplifies small errors from ~layer 26 (CPU pure-bf16 reference also drifts to hidden PCC 0.92), V PCC fell to 0.824 at layer 47
fix: residual stream and TP all-reduce partial sums kept fp32; every matmul/SDPA/GDN input stays bf16

issue: folded (1+w) norm gain in bf16 (minimax pattern) loses w: 87% of entries round, +0.1% per-token scale bias per norm
fix: norms composed in fp32 with fp32 gains (x*rsqrt(mean(x^2)+eps)*g), incl. q/k-norm and GDN gated norm

issue: minimax sets fp32_dest_acc_en=False for every ring SDPA; live-KV ring at hd256 then has 4.1% rel error (CPU bf16 1.0%)
fix: fp32_dest_acc_en=True on the live-KV ring (1.2%); False kept only for the cache-read ring, which refuses it

issue: cache-read ring SDPA refuses fp32_dest_acc_en; with bf8 KV its chunk-2 attention has 5.4% rel error and GDN conv states fell to 0.849
fix: compose the cache read: slice written rows, SP all-gather, plain SDPA with fp32 acc under a host position mask (ring kept via QWEN38_CACHE_ATTN)

issue: fused chunk_gated_delta_rule op is 2.6% (output) / 6.8% (state) off on real inputs vs 0.14% for an fp32 CPU core; no knob moves it
fix: compose the chunked delta rule from ttnn ops in fp32 (C=32, product inverse + 3 Newton steps, clamped exp); fused op kept via QWEN38_GDN_CORE
